INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mart.user_value
WITH aggregated AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM ods.events
  GROUP BY user_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM aggregated
)
SELECT r.user_id
FROM ranked r
JOIN ods.users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id FROM ods.fallback_users
